candidates.name: Jeffrey Solomon
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.background: Jeffrey "Doc" Solomon is a chiropractor from Pinecrest who says he has served South Florida patients for more than 40 years and has taught future health care professionals. He is running with no party affiliation against Republican incumbent Alexis Calatayud and Democrat Richard Lamondin. He previously ran for the Florida House as a Democrat, losing the District 115 race in 2018.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

insurance.summary: Solomon calls the cost of property insurance one of the central problems facing District 38 families, but says he would attack it through transparency and competition rather than by describing direct state intervention such as rate caps or expanding Citizens.
insurance.quote: address the property insurance crisis through transparency and competition

sources.title: Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey: Jeffrey Solomon

healthcare.summary: Solomon, a health care provider, says he would work to lower health insurance premiums, cut prescription drug costs, expand telehealth and mobile health services and improve access to mental health and preventive care. He does not specifically address Medicaid expansion or ACA subsidies.
healthcare.quote: I will fight to lower health insurance premiums, reduce prescription drug costs, expand telehealth and mobile healthcare services, improve access to mental health care

sources.title: Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey: Jeffrey Solomon

housing.summary: Solomon lists housing affordability among his campaign's core issues and says he would support affordable homeownership and make owning a home more attainable, without naming specific programs.

sources.title: Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey: Jeffrey Solomon

environment.summary: Solomon says protecting Florida's environment is one of the policy areas he is personally passionate about and names protecting the Everglades and Biscayne Bay as a campaign goal. He does not discuss trade-offs with development.
environment.quote: protect the Everglades and Biscayne Bay

sources.title: Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey: Jeffrey Solomon
